### Prerequisites (listed separately)

1. `fixed_ext_death_claim_settlement` -> `fixed_ext_death_valuation_interest`, form **state**. policy_source "A beneficiary's death benefit share is not paid until the contract carries the valuation interest credited through the valuation date of the death benefit." — verbatim in `death_benefit_lump_sum_settlement` ("Waiting state"), connective "not ... until" intact; same-form restatement "In other words: ...". In no other document. Resolution basis: `death_benefit_valuation_interest` describes the write in the same words ("crediting the death benefit valuation interest ... closing on the valuation date"); records: latest credit 2025-08-21 (period end 2025-08-20). Strength matches.
2. `fixed_ext_death_valuation_interest` -> `fixed_ext_claim_renewal_rate`, form **state**. policy_source "The death benefit valuation interest is fixed only after the contract carries its renewed guaranteed rate for every guarantee period that ended before the valuation date." — verbatim in `death_benefit_valuation_interest` ("Waiting state"), connective "only after" intact; same-form restatement "Restated: ...". In no other document. Resolution basis: `securerate_default_renewal` ("renews by default ... recorded with the default renewal rate"; table "Guaranteed rate | The default renewal rate"); records: GP end 2026-08-20, rate 0.0555, schedule start 2023-08-21, no renewal election. Strength matches; the edge also bears weight in the figures (before renewal the split rule cannot trigger).

## kb_to_source

All normative sentences of the touched documents trace to extended `rule`/`prerequisite`/`factors`/`baseline`, base `policies` (incl. `eligibility`), `variants` and `task_tools.py`. Additions: none. Rewrites/omissions: none at entailment level. Cross-problem operational guidance: none (each tool name only in its own hub). Opening world state as policy fact: none; worked figures hypothetical. Observation: the 50/30/20 primary pattern in the hypothetical illustrations of `death_benefit_provisions` and `death_claim_share_and_interest_computation` coincides with this task's designation shares, but the illustrations make a different primary predeceased (C, 20%), state no record of this task, and a copier would get a wrong share (62.5%); not a leak.

Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict):
- P1. `parameter_schema.high_band_threshold` / `high_band_rate_addition` describe the high band as applying to "premium (or contract value at renewal)" — the semantics of the retired `fixed_interest_crediting` sentence. The KB carries them as column notes in `declared_interest_rate_schedule` unmarked. Source-side inconsistency between parameter schema and overwrite; the default renewal worksheet and band table state the governing rule, so no second solution arises. (The KB dropped the analogous retired phrase from the `death_claim_interest_rate` description, correctly.)
- P2. The whole life certificate "date received" has no dedicated field; the source compute reads the whole life death claim's `received_date`. The KB wording "the date that certificate was received" plus "whether a certified death certificate was received, and the date received" entails the same field.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** All atoms of the three extended policies (15 factor ladders tier by tier, three baselines, two prerequisites, three tool contracts), the governing base clauses and the retired surface correspond at entailment level. Affected documents: none. First revision.
